name: xiaoyaoclaw-kb-retriever
description: OpenClaw local knowledge-base retriever with progressive search. Navigates layered data_structure.md indexes, enforces learn-before-process for PDF and Excel, bounds retrieval to at most five rounds, and answers with sources. Retrieval is read-only; three optional maintenance scripts write only inside the knowledge base (data_structure.md indexes, derived .txt from PDFs, page PNGs for the OCR path) and run only on explicit request with confirmation. Every write target is resolved to its real path and must stay inside the knowledge-base root, so symlinks cannot redirect a write outside; symlinked folders are never traversed. Windows & macOS ready. 中文：本地知识库检索器——分层索引 + 渐进式检索，核心零依赖；检索只读，三个可选维护脚本（建索引 / PDF 转文本 / PDF 转图片）只写知识库内的文件，需用户点名并确认。

read: knowledge base directory (md/txt/pdf/xlsx and other documents)
write: data_structure.md index files inside the knowledge base (optional, on request)
derived .txt files from PDFs inside the knowledge base (optional, on request)
page_N.png images for the optional PDF-to-image/OCR path inside the knowledge base (optional, on request)
permissions.notes: No cron/daemons/state files. Write targets are validated by real path (symlinks resolved) and must stay inside the knowledge-base root; symlinked folders are never traversed; no file is deleted.
